recs.x:
- SymbOS ( [link] ): preemptive multitasking, windowed GUI, storage on devices up to 128GB, runs on home computers using the Z80 (starting at 4MHz) with up to (_up to_) 1MB of RAM. (I found this rambling but very interesting demo of what it can do with one of the more capable machines it supports: [link] )

- kOS ( [link] ): limited-access OS and brutalist GUI using the K functional programming language (hmm, I should watch this video again)

cites.x: Same on kOS. In case you had not seen them, early kOS screenshots: [link] Featured live in geocar's presentation: [link]

What counts as contribution? [link] seriously, seriously did my head in. I was certainly fascinated by this, but I fear that I'd contribute one character, accidentally put it in the wrong place, break…
